name: gltf-sample-viewer-example
description: The official glTF sample viewer example.

scripts.preinstall: cd ./glTF-Sample-Renderer && npm install && npm run build
scripts.sync:renderer-assets: mkdir -p public/libs public/assets/images && cp -R glTF-Sample-Renderer/dist/libs/. public/libs/ && cp -R glTF-Sample-Renderer/dist/assets/. public/assets/images/
scripts.predev: cd ./glTF-Sample-Renderer && npm run build && cd .. && npm run sync:renderer-assets
scripts.prebuild: cd ./glTF-Sample-Renderer && npm run build && cd .. && npm run sync:renderer-assets
scripts.lint: eslint src tests vite.config.js playwright.config.js glTF-Sample-Renderer/source/**/*.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix src tests vite.config.js playwright.config.js glTF-Sample-Renderer/source/**/*.js
scripts.format: npm run prettier:fix && npm run lint:fix

author: Khronos Group Inc.
